name: a lock leaves the Session's signer live
replace:
THEN /\ sstate' = RevokeSlot /\ slotSid' = None /\ slotGen' = 0
       THEN /\ sstate' = sstate /\ slotSid' = None /\ slotGen' = 0

name: an install keeps the previous signer live
a locked Session's signer is installed
an install reuses the current generation
replace:
/\ slotSid' = sid /\ slotGen' = next /\ next' = next + 1
  /\ slotSid' = sid /\ slotGen' = next /\ next' = next

name: reauthentication binds a signer with no Session
replace:
/\ Bind(s, s)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, stale>>
  /\ Bind(None, s)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, stale>>
